scope: Strict raw static Classic native maps through pinned original createNewState, independent local raw-map conversion and full native session. Original normalized arena and every original/local session tick compared, including required rollover countdown/reset and signed-material contact scenarios. Dynamic/kinematic maps, joints, forces, shrink, np/ng/ig, nondefault masks, capZones, non-Classic modes, friction above 1, negative restitution, malformed polygons and presentation-only fixture fields are explicitly outside scope and rejected by the adapter. Short --ticks runs check trajectories for the requested prefix; full scenario coverage gates apply only when the complete scenario length is requested.
